milestones: 2026-08-13 consultant account disabled; 2026-09-30 account deleted, keys enrolled, PIN set

weakness: No MFA on the TMS, accounting SaaS (owner and bookkeeper), or load board
remediation_plan: Turn on authenticator-app MFA on all three; password manager with unique passphrases

resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; owner and bookkeeper time

milestones: 2026-08-18 training opt-out; 2026-10-31 vendor list; 2026-12-31 notice terms confirmed

remediation_plan: Twice-daily in-transit list; quarterly TMS transaction export; monthly export of files to an encrypted offline drive; stop syncing carrier packets to the laptop
milestones: 2026-09-30 in-transit list routine; 2026-10-31 first monthly export; 2026-12-31 first quarterly TMS export
